reason: I would maybe try the free trial, but I would not pay yet. I know amoCRM is annoying, but my team's data and routines are in it, and I will not move a sales team to a CRM with no references.
objection: Per seat I pay about $15 elsewhere, and a flat $199 for 15 users is not clearly cheaper for my team. There are no customers I can call, and I do not know if support will be any faster than amoCRM's.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three real Uzbek companies my size that I can call and that have used it for months, plus a clear side-by-side showing I pay less than I do now for my number of users.
